notes.title: Feature Updates on V0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since our last update — we hope you're doing well!
We've made several improvements to the features and content in the Early Access build to better reflect the level of polish we originally envisioned.
We’d love for you to try the updated demo and let us know what you think of the changes!

Patch Notes : 0.1.2

Bug Fixes

 Modified Item Navigations, now cannot select Previous Item, The item switch has one button that cycles, also modified item use Input for controller to "D-Pad Up"
 Modified Shop and Inventory system while shopping. If you buy food, it is stored in Stella's backpack rather than Stella's storage; it goes to the storage if your backpack is full.
 Fixed bug where in pause menu input freezes if player navigate left and right on City pause menu
 Removed any text regarding objectives and objective Indicators on Status and Inventory Pause Panel temporarily, to prevent the panel to disappear due to no city objective present.
 "Back To City" in combat pause menu only available when the player already beat the prologue, Fixed the bug where it appears when the player plays the stage for the first time.
 Fixed Bike teleport errors, and oddities when you can teleport on the same bike.
 Fixed Medal not appearing when player skips most animations in Result Screen
 Training Area infinite cost lever has a text called "No Cost" to remind you that you make skills and ultimate bar full and no cost
 Fixed Resolution Data problem, sometimes it generates data that should be filtered, now add Player's display resolutions if they are not in our list, now the capping system so no overboard resolutions should work
 Fixed the money resetting whenever Autosave is triggered, this is due Autosave only accounts one Field Type, now most data can be saved (money, exp, skills, items) regardless of field type
 Fixed wrong and mismatch UI on the Combat Inventory UI when selecting item after Retry/Restart that accidentally select the Index 2 when it supposed to be Index 0 (first item player have)
 Fixed Gamepad bind, that broken after the Item switch reduced to one button.


Balancing and Quality of Life Improvement

 Extended Stella's critical state to 20% HP of Max HP
 Reduced Stella's shield power to 15
 In Challenge Arena 2, the Prisoner at the end should have the free animation triggered
 Replaced Volume Bar slider sprite into a standard unity square
 Adjusted effect tabs in Item Descriptions on shops and inventory
 Allowed control input while Stella is in recovery frames.
 Allowed walk input after landing from a jump/fall. 
 Reduced Stella's default knockout/down time so that she can start to move again earlier.


Sound Upgrades

 Adjusted some of the BGMs and SFXs volume intensity to reduce annoying noises.
 Resampled some instruments from the previous BGMs.
 Changed some SFXs to match the intensity and vibe of the combat better.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS BUILD UPDATE 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hey there! 🎄 Great news this Christmas!

We’ve dropped a new patch for our early access build—read the detail here! 🎉

Patch Notes : 0.1.1

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Gale's dialogue bar would disappear during the Prologue ending (Part 4, right after the Bloody Belly Boss Battle).
 Added autosave points at critical moments in the Prologue to prevent loss of progression after crashes. Autosaves have been added during transitions between gameplay modes (Battle (Prologue Part 1) → Exploration (Flashback) → Battle (Prologue Part 2) → Exploration (Dream Sequence)).
 Fixed a potential game freeze caused by faulty code in the Pause Menu.
 Food sometimes may dropped when executing a successful Heat Meter/QTE Ultimate.
 Added an autosave after the Result Screen.
 Resolved issues with controller stick navigation that cause erratic behavior in some UI menus.
 Fixed a bug that could freeze or crash the game when the player hold the Shield during the first Combat Tutorial.
 Fixed EXP Points from stages that previously cannot be saved.
 Fixed the Hour/Minute/Second format on the load screen menu that are only displaying 12.00.00 AM.

Changes

 Renamed some settings information to avoid misinformation.

Balancing

 Adjusted the Heat Meter's decay rate to improve gameplay flow.
 Lowered Medal Score calculations and thresholds, resulting in reduced prize money. (Note: If you received a large amount of money before this update, consider it a gift! 😊)
 Simplified the first Combat Tutorial for a smoother introduction.
 Increased the range of dodges.

Contents

 You can enable Unlimited Skill and Ultimate points on Training Area.

Other

 Enabled Steam Cloud Saves for the game. 
 Adjusted the naming conventions for the game's save folders.

Because we are adding Steam Cloud and changing the save directory, you may lose your data. If this happens, please follow these steps:
[olist]
 Go to the game save folder and copy all files, including the folder. The save files are located at: \Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\extralife2\_TRIALSOFFAITH
 Paste the old save data into the new location. The new save files are located at: \Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\Extra Life Entertainment\StellaGale
 That’s it! Now you can play the game with your previous save files.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for an even bigger update coming soon, and Merry Christmas! 🎅✨

notes.title: First time joining Steam Next Fest & this is our result!
notes.content:
Hi, it's been two weeks since the Steam Next Fest 2024 event and we wanted to share what we got from the event. Let's begin! 🔥

We got the total 2014 wishlist additions in one week of the event. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/59e4ed2df078e55946f16845bfc239a21de3e0f7.jpg
It's the best wishlist addition that we have ever gotten after over 4 years of development. If you are curious, let us break it down for ya!

The good news!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/cffb6859df2b041147763636c65f9b2191293b9d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/4ca7941354897c21e3c17a0ae3676cf1d620fb78.png
From one month before the event, we announced, update our social media and also released our December build to promote #steamnextfest . So, on the first day of the event, when we're doing livestream, it got 556 wishlist and 590 wishlist on 2nd day. we also got featured!😍🤩

The Bad News!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/bbe80b1961a4ce4885d8bfaa2eb49e2ba010a657.jpg
But, from the third to the fifth day, the wishlist decreased from 186 to 124 to 120😭We got a little sad about the fact, but, fortunately, we already made a plan for the last day of the event to increase the wishlist.

Plan B
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/d186e2b26092195f8fc0a1ccfd6ffc3b05a9846d.png
We made announcement, update our https://elentertainment.itch.io/stellagale/devlog/678926/this-week-were-joining-steam-next-fest page and uploaded our SNF build there, and it got featured for like 3 days. We got on the first row in the RPG game, new game, hack-and-slash game categories, so as you can see the spike on the graph below.

Result!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/dad5d86ff45df0310d80a507d1113532e7e9a46a.jpg
We also doing our last livestream on the day before the last day of the event. As expected, the wishlist is increasing, it got 180 and 175 on the last day. All of these additions really make us want to finish the game because there is someone out there waiting for us. But...


Twist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/e436caba927fe907cb08734c370e8f01ec393974.png
As far as we know, the number of wishlist deletions is also increasing, we got 111 deletions. You can see that even the graph looks similar with addition graph. So, I think player wishlist many game on the first day remove the game if they don't like it after playing the demo.

So, that it our report for our game StellaGale: The Trial of Faith. After all it's our first Steam Next Fest event that we participated and we love the result that we got even it's still looks small number. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/20402ad7148f97f57338bc1ec48587fbd480c4d0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/afc5be2e684734a818a11afd1bc00e3d3aa12b4f.png

What is your Steam Next Fest story? share with us and help other dev!
Also, for those who missed the livestream, we are going to upload our steam next fest dev's play livestream on our YouTube channel. We will be standing by in the chat room, so please add us to your YouTube watch list.
[previewyoutube=LogmMZPBnuA;full][/previewyoutube]

Ciao!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest February 2024 Livestream Event #1!
notes.content:
This is a livestream where our developers play our own game, and you guys can join and ask us anything! Talk about the game itself, or the behind-the-scenes processes!

Here are the schedule for the livestream and our lovely developers, Evan Martin and Marszha Deborah!

The stream will start at February 5th 7PM PT / 6 February 10AM WIB.

These are the schedule for the live QnA!

7PM-8PM PT / 10.00-11.00 WIB for Game Designers and Programmers
8PM-9PM PT / 11.00-12.00 WIB for Background Artists
9PM-10PM PT / 12.00-13.00 WIB for Illustrators
10PM-11PM PT / 13.00-14.00 WIB for Animators


Did you know that we have had a Discord server since 2021? But we have, like, never used it correctly. We know that there is so much room for us to talk about the game that we are working on. So, from now on, we want you to be part of our community. It's still a small community, but like our protagonist, Stella, we hope that we can grow together and understand each other better! 

You can join our Discord server by clicking this link https://discord.gg/6Ke6tW8URD

Let's talk about the game and help each other. See you there :D

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Slash every obstacle the Colosseum has to offer! In this Hand-drawn Hack-n-Slash adventure game, where you play as Stella, a young mechanic who fighting her way up to seek an answer to the mystery of the appearance of her long-lost father. In her desperation to win the fight, a miracle appeared.

FEATURES

FULLY HAND-DRAWN ARTSTYLE
From the dust produced in the arena to the battle between you and your enemies and even the euphoria of the crowd that watching you, everything is meticulously crafted with hand-drawn animations to bring the world of StellaGale to life.
EXCITING & BITTERSWEET STORY ABOUT A JOURNEY TO DISCOVER THE TRUTH
The sweat that drips onto your sword, the tears shed by those who stand by you, and the joy of uncovering the purpose of your journey. All these emotions will engulf you as you play.
UNLEASH YOUR SKILL FROM UNIQUE CONVEYOR SYSTEM Gale will provide you guidance as you navigate the skills and Xtreme mechanics. Use these mechanics to execute, charge, or store your skills for more powerful attacks. This mechanics system will be easy to control and intuitive to use.
ADVANTAGE YOUR SURROUNDING
Look at your surroundings! Traps, barrel, items, and spectator. You can use your surroundings to your advantage to create an exciting combat experience.

notes.title: PLAY THE FULL DEMO NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uCNZZ3B1TYw;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone, we're proudly present our Full Prologue Demo of StellaGale The Trial of Faith!

Embark on a captivating journey with our Full Demo. Explore rich landscapes, unravel the prologue of Stella’s story, and dive into the complete gaming experience. This demo offers a taste of the full adventure that awaits you in the world of StellaGale Trial of Faith.

I also want to share some changes we made for a course a year :

COMBAT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/0e1a3b4b30e05bec2dfb7a2433437b9de9b12156.gif
The gameplay feel has undergone a significant transformation from what it used to be. In the current version, it is evident that every damage dealt is impactful and leaves a strong impression. We added camera shakes, slow motion, splash screens, and updated the damage visual effects to make battles even more engaging and visually appealing.

BACKGROUND COMBAT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/04971b94758d75b3eda4736e2fdbae97f4fa0d4b.gif
We added depth to the arena by incorporating numerous assets into the foreground. Compared to before, which may have seemed empty and close, now players can feel a more dense and expansive arena.

XTREME MODE SYSTEM (Previously called Ultimate / Conveyor System)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/4fc6752a1bdb4fa23063b98c91377a911c529e2a.gif

 The skill conveyor has been slightly modified to make it easier for players to distinguish between the gauge for regular skills and the gauge for Xtreme skills. We have also added controls above the buttons so that players can easily preview the skills they are about to use.
 We removed the storing system to make it easier for players during Xtreme execution. This decision was based on feedback from our testers, as pressing the L1+R1 buttons for storing proved to be cumbersome. As a result, we focused on the core element, which is the combination of skills. Now, players only need to hold L1 and input the combination.


AUDIO & MUSIC

 We made massive changes to the music and audio, successfully incorporating voices that enhance the excitement of battles, including voices for Stella, enemies, and even Gale.
 Added sound effects (SFX) to many parts of the gameplay. This is also a significant change that has a substantial impact on the current state of the game.


STORY DIRECTION & SYSTEM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/2c3399d1e6f37ce04b4a9f26c6faf60a1efac1b5.gif

 Fungus update (control & animation). We added control to fasten & auto-play cutscenes. This will be very useful for players to control their own pace. 
 We added music & audio to cutscene, so the story felt more alive.


EXPLORATION CITY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/40aedba1c2478ff6b3010f7718778f922a47e170.gif

 We added shadows and lighting to the city, as well as visual effects like waves and particle leaves. This makes the city come even more alive.
 Animated Vfx background. We added many VFX animations to improve the visual experience.
 Background assets for the Main City are improved. The city is now more alive. All details are now painted in more detail.


BONUS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41151733/6cab2b116cdc57c434e2f08309261e1c96432e5b.gif
We also added tip or gratuity mechanic to the game. So, when you did something amazing, the crowd will reward you with money. 

******************************************************************************************

The team has done tremendous work and we spend a lot of time making the game better and fully playable. I hope you can feel it when you play the game. If you have feedback or have found any bugs, you can report us on the discussion panel.

Let's meet again at Steam Next Fest February 2024

notes.title: REASON BEHIND OUR ABSENCE IN STEAM NEXT FEST OCT 2023
notes.content:
Hi this is our first Devlog on steam! 👏 My name is Daniel Calvin and I am an animator & director for StellaGale.

First I want to apologize for not participating in Steam Next Fest October 2023 as we had announced at The Indonesian Game Day 2023 live stream on August 18th. We thought we could deliver our best prologue demo, but As we tested our build, we realized that the game needs more time to be ready. 

We want you to have the best experience possible when you play StellaGale, so we are working hard to meet the quality that we desire. Especially the visual and sound that we cared so much about, because StellaGale is an action game.
We are very grateful for your support until now, and we have some good news for you! 👏


You can play our combat demo on Friday 1st Dec 2023 at 18.00 WIB or 11:00 am GMT. The demo consists of combat only gameplay without story context, so you can have fun kicking some enemies!
We have prepared some wallpaper art that you can use for your own device. It’s free so you can also give these wallpaper as a gift to your beloved one.
Bonus! You can watch other Indonesian games that featured on The Indonesian Game Day 2023 here
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qdtM13ZSx-A

We have other good news in the future so please stay tuned with us for our next update! Thanks!

My sincere
Daniel Calvin
Animator & Director
